item.title: 'This case is going to trial': Judge rejects Sam Altman's efforts to toss Elon Musk's OpenAI lawsuit
item.description: An Oakland federal court judge just handed a win to Elon Musk and his legal battle against Sam Altman and OpenAI.

item.title: I'm at CES in Las Vegas to check out the latest in autonomous driving. Here's what I've learned so far.
item.description: Business Insider is on the ground at Las Vegas CES 2026. Here's everything we learned on self-driving cars and robotaxis,

item.title: The biggest — and weirdest —tech coming out of the 2026 Consumer Electronics Show, from robots to AI pets
item.description: Here are the highlights from the world's largest technology trade show in Las Vegas, including a laundry folding robot and an AI pet that can grow.

item.title: Ford is revving up its self-driving ambitions and making key tech in-house
item.description: Ford announced plans to deploy eyes-off driving technology on public roads by 2028. The legacy automaker is making the tech in-house to get there.

item.title: A Ukrainian unit told us how its lone gun-toting robot fought off Russians for 45 straight days
item.description: The NC-13 strike company's commander told Business Insider that the drone's primary objective was to suppress Russian troops from advancing for weeks.

item.title: Replit boss: CEOs can vibe code their own prototypes and don't have to beg engineers for help anymore
item.description: Replit CEO Amjad Masad says CEOs are showing up to meetings with prototypes, and product managers may just be "some of the best vibe coders."

item.title: Ford is throwing its hat into the ring alongside Rivian and making an AI companion in-house
item.description: Ford announced a new AI assistant for its cars, which will help drivers answer specific questions like how much firewood can fit into their trucks.

item.title: Ukrainian pilot says he had to make new F-16 tactics because NATO's original training was for a different type of war
item.description: A Ukrainian F-16 pilot said the initial tactics taught by NATO were based on wars that were "fundamentally different" from Ukraine's fight.

item.title: Matt Damon says cutting one thing out of his diet got him down to his 'high school' weight
item.description: "I did that whole movie at 167 pounds. And I haven't been that light since high school," Matt Damon said.

item.title: Google and chatbot startup Character.AI are settling lawsuits over teen suicides
item.description: Google and Character.AI have agreed to settle multiple lawsuits over chatbot-linked teen suicides.
